verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Appwrite has API references for its SDKs, REST and GraphQL APIs, docs available as Markdown, and quick starts. Nothing documents an interactive API explorer or runnable, try-it-in-browser examples. The axis applies to a BaaS platform, but the specific capability is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
